Date: 2027-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Kwame Mensah (referral) — SRE role (please prioritize)

Hi Olga and Vivek,

Quick intro — Kwame Mensah is an ex-colleague of mine (SRE/infra), currently open to new roles and comes highly recommended for the Senior SRE position. He has strong production incident experience, distributed systems background, and a recent project migrating large-scale KV caches to a quantized serving layer.

Kwame is flexible but would appreciate a first-round screen this week if possible. I attached his resume. Can Olga please pick this up as scheduling owner? Vivek — if you have any firm constraints for first-round availability, flag them and we’ll try to accommodate.

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue 8/13: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 8/14: 09:00–11:30

Thanks — Marissa

Hi Kwame — great to meet you (virtually). Marissa looped me in to get you scheduled. Would you be available for a 45-minute technical screen on Wednesday 8/14 at 10:00am PST? If not, share a couple windows that work and I’ll coordinate.

Quick note on logistics: the first round is a remote technical interview with one of our SRE leads followed by a short system-design task. If you have an updated resume or portfolio links, drop them in reply.

Subject: Debrief: Kwame Mensah — technical screen (8/14)

Quick debrief:
- Overall: Strong troubleshooting instincts, good ownership examples from past incidents.
- Technical: Solid on distributed caches and observability. Struggled a bit with a corner-case around multi-region failover, but thought through trade-offs.
- Recommendation: Move to on-site loop (system design + pair debugging) — provisional yes.
- Next steps: Olga, could you please open an on-site loop and include hiring comp/pay band? Marissa — thank you for the referral; I’ll coordinate availability for the loop next week.

Notes saved: https://app.greenhouse.io/candidates/kwame-mensah/scorecard

Thanks,
Vivek
